related.title: Odoo Inventory：現有、保留與可承諾庫存
related.titleEn: Odoo Inventory: on-hand, reserved and promiseable stock
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 cohorts.csv、包含關係與kill-switch回歸結果。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver cohorts.csv,cohort inclusion and kill-switch regression results.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 逐事件列on_hand/reserved/available：初保留後100/50/50，出貨後70/20/50；另核對出貨加在庫仍為100。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: After reservation track100/50/50,and after shipment70/20/50;verify shipped plus on-hand remains100. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 1000*5/100 = 50 users；對照 1000*10/100 = 100 users。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐id列桶與兩個旗標，確認50與100且舊群無流失；此均勻列舉非真實hash樣本的統計保證。

基準 100-30-20 = 50 available-units；對照 (100-30)-20 = 50 available-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐事件列on_hand/reserved/available：初保留後100/50/50，出貨後70/20/50；另核對出貨加在庫仍為100。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 1000*5/100 = 50 users; comparison 1000*10/100 = 100 users. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Enumerate IDs,buckets and both flags,verify50 and100 with no lost original members;this balanced enumeration is not a statistical guarantee for real hashes.

Baseline 100-30-20 = 50 available-units; comparison (100-30)-20 = 50 available-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
After reservation track100/50/50,and after shipment70/20/50;verify shipped plus on-hand remains100.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
